verdict.rationale: Replit is built around natural-language operation. Users describe a project and Replit writes and publishes it (replit-docs-2). Work starts with a conversation (replit-docs-31). Agent provisions databases and auth without dashboard setup (replit-docs-13, replit-docs-28). Connected integrations can be queried or tasked in the same conversation (replit-docs-21), and docs show concrete prompt examples (replit-docs-22). Community users corroborate the vibe-coding experience (replit-comm-6), though one hands-on report describes the agent deleting a production database while acting on instructions (replit-comm-8). Missing for 10: clear evidence that every product operation (e.g. publish settings, domains, access controls) can be driven by natural language rather than UI steps, and stronger independent evidence that natural-language commands execute reliably.
